messages:
raj.platform: quick q — when a circuit-breaker trips at routing layer, should we expose that explicitly to clients or keep it internal and only surface hint headers/console badges? thinking about UX for teams that rely on predictable failures vs noisy errors.

marta-product: leaning toward a client-visible signal but only for quota-style failures and planned degradation. customers want clear reason codes for analytics. otherwise they just retry and blow budgets. :thinking_face:

lee-eng: +1 to a signal, but we need to be careful about semantics. e.g. 429 for rate vs 503 for backend degradation vs a new structured hint like `x-rdwd-failure-mode: circuit_break`. we should avoid inventing too many top-level HTTP codes.

alice.dev: can we keep HTTP status generic (5xx/4xx) and add a machine-readable header + a client enum in SDKs? then Console can map header -> badge + docs link. header example: `x-redwood-failure=cb;policy=queue;retry_after=30`

sam-sre: that header idea sounds good. also suggest adding a short `retry_hint` string for non-programmatic clients, e.g. `Retry-After: 30` and `x-redwood-hint: "degraded-capacity, try-lower-batch"`. we should standardize names.

raj.platform: OK. couple of followups — 1) telemetry: do we emit separate metric for client-visible CBs vs internal suppressed CBs? 2) rollout UX: how will console show canary vs global CB behavior?

lee-eng: metrics: yes — two counters (cb_exposed, cb_internal) + histogram for windowed rate. that makes alerting + chargeback clean. for rollout UX, Console should show effective routing policy per tenant with an indicator if fallback was client-visible. small badge on route + drilldown timeline.

marta-product: for the console badge copy: something short like "degraded: fallback active" with tooltip explaining causes. also add a toggle in rollout page: "Expose circuit-breakers to clients" so teams can opt-in during canaries.

alice.dev: SDK behavior: default to honoring header and surface a structured exception type (e.g., RedwoodCircuitBreakerError) with fields `mode` and `retry_after`. docs snippet we can use in SDKs: ```js
if (res.headers['x-redwood-failure']?.startsWith('cb')) {
  throw new RedwoodCircuitBreakerError({ mode: 'circuit_break', retryAfter: +res.headers['retry-after'] || null })
}
```

infra-bot: deploy finished: routing-policy-2024-11 rolled to staging. CB header changed to `x-rdwd-cb` for short term; will sync tomorrow.

sam-sre: one more ops note — we must ensure that exposing CBs doesn't create a fingerprinting vector for noisy tenants. add rate-limited telemetry and obfuscation in public docs. privacy/compliance will flag raw tenant ids.

raj.platform: great points. action items I captured: 1) RFC for header schema + SDK exception contract (lee + alice) 2) telemetry counters + dashboard mock (sam + lee) 3) console badge/canary toggle copy + tooltip (marta) 4) security review for leakage and obfuscation (raj). i'll open threads and ping owners. thanks all :rocket:
